description: Removes what one dxf_import created, with the plugin's own removal rules: it refuses unless the import's master group is in the open model; deletes the import's elements, then its nodes, only where they still match the fingerprint taken before writing (anything edited since is kept, and a node another element uses is kept); deletes the groups and default properties it created once nothing uses them; switches the model's length unit back if the import changed it and it is unchanged since. Works after a partial import too. Default: the latest dxf_import not yet undone. Previews (what would be removed and kept) unless apply: true.
name: dxf_import_undo
title: Undo a dxf_import
